start.title: [TODO:tr] He Is Passing By
start.text:
[TODO:tr] The Teacher walks through the press.
Twelve years of pain ache in you.

stay_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Rise and Go
stay_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Healing waits where he walks.
Do not be left behind.

coins_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Seek the Healer
coins_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Silver cannot mend what bleeds.
Only he can.

approach.title: [TODO:tr] Closer, Closer
approach.text:
[TODO:tr] Shoulders press, eyes do not see you.
His robe is near.

choices.feedback: [TODO:tr] If only I touch his cloak.

touch.title: [TODO:tr] The Hem
touch.text:
[TODO:tr] Your fingers brush the edge.
A stillness floods your bones.

pull_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] It Is Done
pull_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] The bleeding has stopped.
Receive what he has given.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Feel the Peace
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] Twelve years of pain are gone.
This is grace.

healed.title: [TODO:tr] Made Whole
healed.text:
[TODO:tr] Strength returns. Light fills you.
Then he stops walking.

slip_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Do Not Hide
slip_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] His gaze searches the crowd.
He wants to see you.

who_touched.title: [TODO:tr] Who Touched Me?
who_touched.text:
[TODO:tr] "Who touched my garment?"
The disciples shake their heads.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] He Is Gentle
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] There is no anger in him.
Come forward.

deny_consequence.title: [TODO:tr] Speak the Truth
deny_consequence.text:
[TODO:tr] His mercy welcomes your story.
Do not be afraid.

confess.title: [TODO:tr] Trembling at His Feet
confess.text:
[TODO:tr] You tell him everything.
The whole street goes quiet.

peace.title: [TODO:tr] Daughter, Go in Peace
peace.text:
[TODO:tr] "Daughter, your faith has healed you.
Go in peace."
